usdRate.sourceName: Czech National Bank exchange rate fixing (daily)
usdRate.note: CZK 21.814 per US dollar and CZK 24.360 per euro on 30 October 2026; World Bank 2025 average 21.88.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Trading Economics (Czech Statistical Office CPI, September 2026 final)
inflation_cpi.note: CPI 2.5% year on year in September 2026 (1.9% in August), final figure released 13 October 2026; secondary source because csu.gov.cz was not read directly. World Bank 2025 average 2.5%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: Czech National Bank 2% CPI target with a ±1 point tolerance band; CPI 2.5% (Sep 2026)
inflation_projection.note: The CNB target is credible, but Czech inflation has averaged above 2% in recent years, so 2.5% is used for planning.

policy_rate.sourceName: Czech National Bank, two-week repo rate history
policy_rate.note: 2W repo rate raised from 3.50% to 3.75% with effect from 19 June 2026.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Czech banks, household overnight deposits in CZK (new business)
savings_account_rate.note: Average 1.54% on household overnight deposits (current and most savings accounts) in August 2026; notice deposits up to 3 months paid 1.94%.

fdr_3m_rate.note: ECB/CNB MFI statistics publish household deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year as one bucket (3.38% in August 2026); no 3-month rate was found.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Czech banks, household deposits in CZK with agreed maturity up to 1 year (new business)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Bucket covers all fixed terms up to one year; 1-2 years paid 3.56% and over 2 years 3.51% in August 2026.

dps_rate.note: Czechia's regular-saving product is building savings (stavební spoření) with a state contribution; no current average rate was found from an official source.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI FR.INR.DPST (deposit interest rate)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average deposit rate 1.60% in 2025, pulled down by low-rate sight deposits.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.sourceName: Ministry of Finance, Dluhopisy Republiky: interest rate of the Flexi bond issued 15 October 2026
sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: The retail savings bond now on sale is the Flexi bond, an exchangeable 3-month state treasury bill for individuals that renews automatically; 3.75% a year for 15 Oct 2026 to 15 Jan 2027. No 5-year retail bond is currently offered.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Ministry of Finance, Dluhopisy Republiky: Flexi bond (exchangeable state treasury bill) issue of 15 October 2026
tbill_91d_rate.note: Retail 3-month state treasury bill rate (15 Oct 2026 to 15 Jan 2027); yields on institutional treasury bill auctions were not found.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No 5-year Czech government bond yield found: Trading Economics showed only the 10-year yield and worldgovernmentbonds.com did not load data.

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Czech Republic 10-year government bond yield
tbond_10y_rate.note: ECB long-term (10-year) convergence yield for Czechia was 5.24% in September 2026.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Czech Republic income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: 15% final withholding tax on interest from deposit accounts for resident individuals.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: Ministry of Finance, Dluhopisy Republiky: Flexi bond
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: Yields on the retail Flexi bond are exempt from income tax, unlike term deposit interest.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Garanční systém finančního trhu (Financial Market Guarantee System), deposit insurance
deposit_insurance_limit.note: Cover is the equivalent of EUR 100,000 per depositor per bank (up to EUR 100,000 more in special cases); converted at the CNB rate of CZK 24.360 per euro on 30 October 2026.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: Czech law sets no specific cap on credit card rates and no typical card rate was found; the ECB/CNB series for card credit to households returned no data.

equity_return_low.sourceName: PX index 2,648 on 29 Oct 2026, up 11.5% in a year, near its September 2026 all-time high
equity_return_low.note: Low case: Czech shares, a small bank- and utility-heavy market, earn only a little more than tax-free state bills.

equity_return_base.sourceName: PX index (Trading Economics); Flexi bond 3.75% tax-free
equity_return_base.note: Base case: about 3 points over the tax-free state bill rate, kept within the 4-point limit despite the PX's strong recent run.

equity_return_high.sourceName: PX index (Trading Economics); global equity long-run returns
equity_return_high.note: High case: a diversified equity fund matching long-run global equity returns plus Czech inflation above the euro area.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Gold USD 3,876/oz on 30 Oct 2026, 31% below the January 2026 high
gold_return_low.note: Low case: gold barely keeps up after the 2025-26 spike while the koruna holds firm against the dollar.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold price history (Trading Economics); CZK 21.8 per USD (CNB)
gold_return_base.note: Base case: dollar gold rises roughly with world inflation plus a little, and the koruna is assumed stable against the dollar over the long run.

gold_return_high.note: High case: a repeat of gold's strong 2005-2025 trend in koruna terms.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Household deposits up to 1 year 3.38% less 15% tax = 2.9%, with rates drifting lower
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: bank term deposits after tax if CNB rates fall.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Flexi bond 3.75% tax-free; 1-year deposit 2.9% after tax
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: rolling tax-free retail state bills and term deposits, slightly below the current Flexi bond rate.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: holding long Czech government bonds after tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The CNB and the Czech Insurance Association publish premium and claims totals but no industry life claim settlement ratio could be found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life (rizikové životní pojištění) is widely sold, but no published premium table or regulator data on term premiums per sum insured was found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Hospital care is covered by compulsory public health insurance with no hospital fee for most patients; no official figure for a typical out-of-pocket private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: Private health insurance is a small market of supplementary policies not priced per sum insured; no premium table per CZK 100,000 of cover was found.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Eurostat/ECB HICP Czechia, health: 3.3% year on year in December 2025
goal_inflation_health.note: Health prices have run above headline inflation; 4.5% is used as a long-run planning figure.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Eurostat/ECB HICP Czechia, education: 4.1% year on year in December 2025
goal_inflation_education.note: Education prices (mainly private schools and courses; public education is free) rise faster than headline inflation; 4.5% is used for planning.

life_expectancy.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_expectancy.note: Men 77.5, women 83.0 (UN WPP estimate for 2026); World Bank 2024 figure 80.0.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years computed from georank's expected age at death by current age (UN WPP 2026 estimate).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 33.2 (2025, World Bank), 42.2 (2040) and 51.3 (2065, populationpyramid.net/czech-republic/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Czech Social Security Administration (ČSSZ), retirement age
retirement_age_default.note: 65 for men born 1965-1971; men born 1962 (retiring in 2026) retire at 64 years 6 months; women's age depends on children raised and is converging; rises gradually to 67 for people born after 1988. 35 insurance years required.

retirement_age_government.note: Government employees are in the general pension insurance scheme; no source read stated a separate mandatory retirement age for civil servants.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Household deposits up to 1 year 3.38% less 15% tax = 2.9%, with rates drifting lower
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: bank term deposits after tax if CNB rates fall.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case capped below the tax-free retail state bill rate.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: a ladder of longer government bonds after tax, below the current 10-year yield.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if shares lag.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half shares at 7% and half safe fixed income at about 3.3-4.5% after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning balanced mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: European Commission, Your social security rights in the Czech Republic (July 2026)
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Czechia has no non-contributory old-age pension; older people with low income can claim the means-tested state social assistance benefit (dávka státní sociální pomoci) introduced on 1 October 2025.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension exists in Czechia, so there are no eligibility ages; low-income older people rely on means-tested state social assistance.

gratuity_rule.note: The Labour Code gives severance pay (odstupné) only on redundancy, as a flat 1-3 months' average earnings by length of service rather than days per year, and there is no statutory retirement gratuity; the Labour Code text was not read.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Czech Social Security Administration (ČSSZ), retirement age
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory pay-as-you-go pension insurance (social security 7.1% employee and 24.8% employer in 2026, per PwC); pension age 65 rising to 67 for those born after 1988. Pensions are raised every January by law (price growth plus part of real wage growth); that rule was not confirmed on a page read.

dps.note: Regular saving with building societies over at least 6 years, with a yearly state contribution.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: Sold by the Ministry of Finance directly to individuals with no fee via an online asset account; currently a 3-month bill that renews automatically, interest tax-free, early repayment without penalty.

tbill_91d.note: Retail investors buy them as the Flexi bond; institutional bills are auctioned by the CNB for the Ministry of Finance.

equity_fund.note: Gains on securities held over 3 years are tax-exempt.

gold.note: No restriction on buying physical gold; investment gold is VAT-exempt in the EU.

insuranceRegulator.name: Česká národní banka (Czech National Bank), financial market supervision
insuranceRegulator.note: The CNB supervises insurers as well as banks.

insuranceComplaints.name: Finanční arbitr (Financial Arbiter)
insuranceComplaints.note: Out-of-court disputes with financial institutions, including life insurance.

pensionScheme.name: Česká správa sociálního zabezpečení (Czech Social Security Administration)

publicHealthCover.name: Všeobecná zdravotní pojišťovna (General Health Insurance Company, public health insurance)
publicHealthCover.note: Largest of the public health insurance funds under compulsory health insurance.

depositInsurance.name: Garanční systém finančního trhu (Financial Market Guarantee System)
